finalText:
700 tests ran, 698 passed, 2 failed — both in `auth/tokens.test.js`.

1. **`refreshToken silently accepts an already-revoked token`** — `auth/tokens.test.js:400`
2. **`sessionCleanup leaves orphaned rows after a rollback`** — `auth/tokens.test.js:650`

The first one is worth a look before anything else — a revoked token still being accepted is a real security gap, not just a flaky test.
